en: Color view of a low, white market complex with stone bases and tiled roofs, signed with large blue letters reading BAZAR. There is a wooden entrance gate, flower beds in the foreground, and pine trees and resort buildings in the background. Festive bunting hangs through the stalls and a few people walk in the courtyard. The reverse is a standard divided-back card with Romanian text and pricing.
